note: Three development transcripts in which a truthful subject answers every question responsively and every claim matches a released record: each sentence carries one or two verbatim quotes of an initial document or a record released before that question that state its numbers, words and polarity. Families whose truthful explanation appears in records were chosen (F06, F07, F08). The transcripts are in dev_transcripts.json. Each cooperative transcript was reviewed by an independent session for consistency and responsiveness (transcript_review.json).
